summary: Implementation plan for v4.3.0 addressing: (1) Learn mode board-first focus matching regular play with auto-focus on Next Step upon completion and Zone Switch for side controls, (2) fixing the '+' button rapid open/close double-trigger bug, (3) Lichess matchmaking blurred board + live matchmaking modal that waits until opponent & color are confirmed plus server clock sync on every move and freezing clocks on the first move, and (4) fixing Checko TTS on MyPC with multi-provider fallback and a new Settings section showing the active MyPC TTS AI model and voice tester.
